name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, and ZAR by carry-to-vol each month (local 3M interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds, divided by 21-day realized FX vol). Shows next-month EM/USD returns for each carry-to-vol rank (1=lowest, 3=highest) over the last 5 years. Includes a summary table with N, median return, and hit rate per rank.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does ranking EM currencies by carry-to-vol predict next-month returns?
#
# Methodology:
#   - Carry = local 3M interbank rate (%) minus USD Fed Funds rate (%)
#   - Vol    = 21-day annualized realized vol of daily FX returns (converted to %)
#   - Carry-to-vol = carry / vol_pct  (both in % units)
#   - cs_rank across 3 assets: rank 1 = lowest, rank 3 = highest carry-to-vol
#   - FX return = -(USD/EM return) = EM/USD perspective (positive = EM strengthens)
#   - Forward return = next calendar month's EM/USD return (monthly bars)
#
# Interest rate sources (FRED, monthly):
#   BRL: IRSTCI01BRM156N  (Brazil call money/interbank rate, current through Jan 2026)
#   MXN: IR3TIB01MXM156N  (Mexico 3M interbank rate, current through Jan 2026)
#   ZAR: IR3TIB01ZAM156N  (South Africa 3M interbank rate, current through Jan 2026)
#   USD: FEDFUNDS          (Fed Funds effective rate, monthly)
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary FX data (USD/EM pairs) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# --- Interest rates (monthly FRED, ffilled to daily) ---
usd_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='FEDFUNDS')().result)

brl_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')().result)
mxn_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')().result)
zar_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')().result)

# Select the correct local rate per asset context (ticker = base symbol only)
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')()

local_rate = conditional_select(
    is_brl, brl_rate,
    is_mxn, mxn_rate,
    zar_rate
)

# Carry = local rate minus USD funding cost (both in %)
carry = local_rate - usd_rate

# --- Realized volatility (21-day, annualized) ---
# vol output is decimal fraction (e.g., 0.20 = 20%); convert to % for unit consistency
vol_pct = volatility(period=21)(src.c) * 100.0

# Carry-to-vol: guard against near-zero vol
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(vol_pct) and vol_pct > 0.1, carry / vol_pct)

# --- Downsample to monthly ---
ctv_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(carry_to_vol)
close_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(src.c)

# --- Cross-sectional rank on monthly carry-to-vol ---
# rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, rank 3 = highest (top carry)
rank_monthly = cs_rank(ascending=True)(ctv_monthly)

# --- Monthly EM/USD forward return ---
# forward_returns on USD/EM close → negate for EM/USD perspective
fwd_ret_em = -(forward_returns(period=1)(close_monthly))

# NaN-propagate rank label so only valid rank bars contribute to bar chart
rank_nan_flag = rank_monthly / rank_monthly
rank_label = rank_monthly * rank_nan_flag

# --- Isolate returns by rank for summary stats ---
ret_rank1 = where(is_valid(rank_monthly) and rank_monthly == 1, fwd_ret_em)
ret_rank2 = where(is_valid(rank_monthly) and rank_monthly == 2, fwd_ret_em)
ret_rank3 = where(is_valid(rank_monthly) and rank_monthly == 3, fwd_ret_em)

# Hit rate: ternary 1/0 so Mean = actual frequency (not where-literal trap)
hit_rank1 = 1.0 if (is_valid(ret_rank1) and ret_rank1 > 0) else 0.0
hit_rank2 = 1.0 if (is_valid(ret_rank2) and ret_rank2 > 0) else 0.0
hit_rank3 = 1.0 if (is_valid(ret_rank3) and ret_rank3 > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Does carry-to-vol rank predict next-month returns?
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Does Carry-to-Vol Rank Predict Next-Month Returns?',
    category='1. Carry-to-Vol Signal',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month EM/USD Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Rank (1=Lowest, 3=Highest)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Next-Month Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=fwd_ret_em, label=rank_label)

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: N, Median, Hit Rate, Mean by rank
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Next-Month Return Stats by Carry-to-Vol Rank',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['N (months)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% positive)', 'Mean Return'],
        col_headers=['Rank 1 (Lowest)', 'Rank 2 (Mid)', 'Rank 3 (Highest)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Carry-to-Vol Signal',
    order=1
)(ret_rank1, ret_rank2, ret_rank3, ret_rank1, ret_rank2, ret_rank3, hit_rank1, hit_rank2, hit_rank3, ret_rank1, ret_rank2, ret_rank3)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Carry-to-vol over time (context — how the signal has evolved)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Over Time (Monthly)',
    category='2. Signal Context',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol (carry % / realized vol %)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero carry')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry-to-Vol', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ctv_monthly)
